title: When Disputes Happen, Evidence Rules Everything
meta_description: Package disappeared? Phone not working? Here's how real dispute resolution works: shipping receipts, weight verification, photo analysis. Evidence beats excuses.
content:
When Disputes Happen, Evidence Rules Everything

A customer's been fighting for two months. Royal Mail weight proof shows 1kg package delivered. Seller's security team claims empty box. Guess who's getting ignored?

Not the customer's fault. Not even unusual anymore.

The Evidence Standard That Actually Works

When something goes wrong with your order — package missing, phone not working, condition different than described — evidence decides everything. Not who yells loudest or writes the longest emails.

Real dispute resolution starts with documentation. Shipping receipts with weight verification. Photo timestamps. Tracking data with GPS coordinates. Chat transcripts with exact quotes.

Because when push comes to shove, proof beats promises every single time.

Here's how we actually investigate disputes: First, we pull the shipping receipt from our carrier showing exact weight and dimensions. If you ordered an iPhone 14 Pro (weight: 7.3 oz), the package should weigh exactly that plus packaging materials — roughly 12-14 oz total.

Next comes photo analysis. Every phone we ship gets photographed before packaging — screen test, battery percentage, condition grade verification. If you claim different condition, we compare your photos to our pre-ship documentation.

iPhone 14 Pro -- Excellent from $549

Documented condition, photographed battery health, trackable shipping with weight verification.

Check availability

Why Other Sellers Ignore Evidence

Investigating disputes costs money. Easier to ignore customers, hope they go away, or blame shipping companies for everything.

But evidence doesn't lie. Package weighs 1kg? Something's inside. GPS shows delivery to correct address? It arrived. Pre-ship photos show 91% battery health? That's what you should receive.

The moment a seller starts dismissing documentation, you know they're not running an evidence-based operation. They're running damage control.

What Fair Resolution Looks Like

Fair resolution means looking at facts, not making customers prove their innocence. If tracking shows package delivered but you didn't receive it, we file the carrier claim and send replacement immediately.

If your phone arrives with different battery health than listed, we check our pre-ship documentation. Mistake on our end? Full refund or replacement. Documentation matches? We troubleshoot together until resolved.

Every email answered. Every concern addressed. Every piece of evidence reviewed. Until resolution.

That's not revolutionary customer service. That's just not abandoning people when problems happen.

mainEntity.name: What evidence do you use to resolve shipping disputes?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use shipping receipts with weight verification, pre-ship photography, tracking data with GPS coordinates, and detailed documentation of every device's condition before packaging.

mainEntity.name: What if my refurbished phone arrives in different condition than described?

acceptedAnswer.text: We compare your photos to our pre-ship documentation. If there's a discrepancy on our end, we provide full refund or replacement. If documentation matches, we troubleshoot together until resolved.

mainEntity.name: How long do dispute resolutions take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every email gets answered, every piece of evidence gets reviewed. We don't abandon customers when problems happen - resolution continues until the issue is completely resolved to your satisfaction.
